html:
G'oya

Ikki bosqich, ikkalasi ham window funksiya bilan. Birinchisi: har (mahsulot, rasta) juftligida kunlarni kamayish tartibida raqamlaymiz, rn = 1 so'nggi narx. Ikkinchisi: qolgan narxlarni mahsulot ichida saralab raqamlaymiz va yoniga mahsulotdagi rastalar sonini yozamiz. O'rtadagi bir yoki ikki qatorning o'rtachasi mediana.

Yechim

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT product, price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product, stall ORDER BY day DESC) AS rn
  FROM price_checks
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT product, price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY price) AS pos,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY product) AS cnt
  FROM latest
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT product, AVG(price) AS median_price
FROM ranked
WHERE pos IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY product

(cnt + 1) / 2 va (cnt + 2) / 2 butun sonli bo'lish. Toq cnt da ikkalasi bir xil (5 ta rastada 3 va 3), juft cnt da qo'shni ikki o'rin (4 tada 2 va 3). Pomidorning so'nggi narxlari 8 000, 9 500, 11 000, 13 000: mediana 10 250.

Tuzoqlar

So'nggi narxni ajratmasdan hamma yozuvlardan mediana olish. Pomidorda 7 ta yozuv bor, o'rtadagisi 9 500 va javob 10 250 o'rniga 9 500 chiqadi. A-12 rastasi uch marta tekshirilgan, shu uch yozuv medianani o'z tomoniga tortadi:

Noto'g'riWITH r AS (
  SELECT product, price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY price, id) AS pos,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY product) AS cnt
  FROM price_checks
)
SELECT product, AVG(price) AS median_price
FROM r
WHERE pos IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY product

Rastaning eng qimmat narxini olish ham xato: so'nggi narx arzonlashgan bo'lishi mumkin. Juftda faqat bitta o'rtani olish yoki SUM / COUNT bilan butun sonli o'rtacha 4 500.5 o'rniga 4 500 beradi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da medianani PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) bir o'zi hisoblaydi, SQLite'da bunday funksiya yo'q. So'nggi narxni ajratish bosqichi esa ikkala bazada ham kerak.
